_source: Copied from Aurum-Life-Desktop @ 5daba49a. Re-copy when the app adds a built-in template, trigger kind, artifact kind or recurrence form. Sources: content/templates/*.md (life_os/builtin_templates.rs), src-tauri/src/automations.rs (TriggerKind, ArtifactKind), src-tauri/src/store/tasks.rs (RECURRENCE_GRAMMAR), content/blueprints/*.md (built-in blueprint area names).

builtinTemplates.name: Board meeting
builtinTemplates.description: One project per board meeting: pre-read, metrics, decisions asked for, and follow-ups with owners.

builtinTemplates.name: Compliance control
builtinTemplates.description: One control with its evidence cycle as recurring tasks - including annual reviews that actually repeat.

builtinTemplates.name: Content pipeline
builtinTemplates.description: Ideas, production, approvals and performance in one project, with stages as sections so the board view works.

builtinTemplates.name: Course
builtinTemplates.description: Work through a course with dated modules, spaced study blocks and a revision pass before the assessment.

builtinTemplates.name: Cover letter
builtinTemplates.description: A short cover letter: why them, why you, what you would do first.

builtinTemplates.name: Development plan
builtinTemplates.description: Link a person's career goal to the skills that get them there, the feedback they have had, and dated checkpoints.

builtinTemplates.name: Feedback themes
builtinTemplates.description: Cluster raw feedback into themes with evidence counts, so the loudest voice does not become the roadmap.

builtinTemplates.name: Habit tracker
builtinTemplates.description: Turn habits into daily repeating tasks with a weekly streak table and an honest keep/change/drop review.

builtinTemplates.name: Household chores
builtinTemplates.description: A recurring chore rota - every line is a real repeating task, not a checklist you re-tick by hand.

builtinTemplates.name: Job application
builtinTemplates.description: One project per application: pipeline stage, tailored materials, interview prep and dated follow-ups.

builtinTemplates.name: Marketing campaign
builtinTemplates.description: A campaign organised by objective, channel, assets and deadlines, with a results section that gets filled in.

builtinTemplates.name: Meeting notes
builtinTemplates.description: Decisions and owners, not a transcript. Actions come out as tasks with dates.

builtinTemplates.name: Metrics log
builtinTemplates.description: A single place to record a metric over time with its target, so a trend is visible instead of remembered.

builtinTemplates.name: Month-end close
builtinTemplates.description: The close checklist as real monthly repeating tasks with working-day deadlines and a sign-off.

builtinTemplates.name: Monthly budget and bills
builtinTemplates.description: Every bill as a real monthly repeating task, plus a budget-versus-actual table and a renewal watch list.

builtinTemplates.name: Onboarding 30/60/90
builtinTemplates.description: Dated 30, 60 and 90 day checkpoints with what good looks like at each, so progress is intentional.

builtinTemplates.name: Onboarding plan
builtinTemplates.description: A consistent first two weeks for a new hire: access, people, context and a first shipped thing.
A one-to-one note: their agenda first, then yours, then commitments with owners.

builtinTemplates.name: Operational checklist
builtinTemplates.description: A recurring operational routine where each run is auditable - who did it, when, and what they found.

builtinTemplates.name: Person
builtinTemplates.description: A relationship page: recurring check-in, commitments you made, a contact log and a yearly birthday reminder.

builtinTemplates.name: Portfolio piece
builtinTemplates.description: A case-study write-up of one piece of work: context, what you did, the outcome and what you would change.

builtinTemplates.name: Product spec
builtinTemplates.description: Problem, users, scope and success criteria before any solution - with open decisions tracked explicitly.

builtinTemplates.name: Purchase decision
builtinTemplates.description: Compare options against criteria you set first, then record the decision and when to revisit it.

builtinTemplates.name: Reading queue
builtinTemplates.description: A queue of books, articles and videos with a next-up rule, so the list gets consumed rather than collected.

builtinTemplates.name: Remediation plan
builtinTemplates.description: Close a finding properly: root cause, corrective actions with owners and dates, and evidence of closure.

builtinTemplates.name: Resume
builtinTemplates.description: A resume skeleton with achievement-shaped bullets - verb, scope, measurable outcome.

builtinTemplates.name: Risk register
builtinTemplates.description: Risks scored by likelihood and impact, each with an owner, a mitigation and a review date.

builtinTemplates.name: Savings goal
builtinTemplates.description: Turn a target and a date into a monthly contribution that actually repeats, plus a progress ledger.

builtinTemplates.name: Skills matrix
builtinTemplates.description: Rate skills against the level a target role needs, so gaps become a learning plan rather than a feeling.

builtinTemplates.name: Sleep review
builtinTemplates.description: Two weeks of sleep data reviewed against what you actually did, to find the two levers that matter.

builtinTemplates.name: Training program
builtinTemplates.description: A dated training block with sessions, conditioning, recovery and a performance log.

builtinTemplates.name: Trip
builtinTemplates.description: Plan a trip end to end - bookings, itinerary, packing and documents in one project.

builtinTemplates.name: Vendor
builtinTemplates.description: One project per vendor: renewal deadline, contract, owner, spend and a decision log.

builtinTemplates.name: Weekly meal plan
builtinTemplates.description: Seven days of meals with a shopping list derived from them.

recurrenceGrammar: daily | weekly | weekly:mon,wed,fri | monthly | monthly:<1-31> | quarterly | yearly
